name: renodx
readmeExcerpt:
# renodx
RenoDX, short for "Renovation Engine for DirectX Games", is a toolset to mod games. Currently it can replace shaders, inject buffers, add overlays, upgrade swapchains, upgrade texture resources, and write user settings to disk. Because RenoDX uses Reshade's add-on system, compatibility is expected to be pretty wide. Using Reshade simplifies all the hooks necessary to tap into DirectX without worrying about patching version-specific exe files.


# Contributing

* See [CONTRIBUTING.md](./docs/CONTRIBUTING.md)
* For the live devkit and MCP workflow, see [DEVKIT_MCP.md](./docs/DEVKIT_MCP.md)

# Mods

* See [Mods page](https://github.com/clshortfuse/renodx/wiki/Mods)

# Utilities

* [renodx-fpslimiter.addon64](https://clshortfuse.github.io/renodx/renodx-fpslimiter.addon64) – FPS Limiter
* [renodx-devkit.addon64](https://clshortfuse.github.io/renodx/renodx-devkit.addon64) – Developer kit to help build addons
* [decomp.exe](https://clshortfuse.github.io/renodx/decomp.exe) – Shader Model 6.0+ Decompiler

aiSummary.oneLiner: A modding toolset for injecting modern rendering features and custom shaders into existing DirectX games
aiSummary.whatItDoes: RenoDX (Renovation Engine for DirectX Games) provides developers with a robust framework to enhance the graphics of compiled DirectX games without modifying their original executables. By hooking into the graphics pipeline via the Reshade add-on system, it achieves broad compatibility across different game versions. The toolset allows modders to replace native shaders, inject custom memory buffers, add overlays, and upgrade texture resources on the fly. It also includes development utilities like a Shader Model 6.0+ decompiler and an FPS limiter to assist in creating complex graphical mods.
keyFeatures: Reshade integration: hooks into the DirectX pipeline using Reshade's add-on architecture, bypassing the need for executable patching.
Dynamic shader replacement: enables developers to intercept and swap out existing game shaders with custom implementations at runtime.
Resource upgrading: supports modifying swapchains and upgrading texture resolutions to significantly improve visual fidelity.
Custom buffer injection: allows the creation and injection of new buffers for implementing advanced, non-native rendering techniques.
Shader decompilation: includes decomp.exe, a utility for decompiling modern Shader Model 6.0+ shaders to facilitate reverse engineering.
Developer toolkit: provides an SDK and an FPS limiter addon to streamline the creation and testing of visual modifications.

useCases.title: Retro Game Remastering
useCases.description: Allows modders to inject modern lighting models, such as HDR or ray tracing approximations, into older DirectX titles.

useCases.title: Visual Bug Fixing
useCases.description: Enables graphics programmers to identify, decompile, and patch broken shaders in unsupported games.

useCases.title: Performance Optimization
useCases.description: Helps users improve frame pacing and resource management by upgrading legacy swapchains and utilizing custom FPS limiters.

useCases.title: Custom HUD Injection
useCases.description: Provides the hooks necessary for developers to draw custom overlays, telemetry data, or entirely new user interfaces over the game.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: RenoDX is intended for graphics programmers, technical game modders, and reverse engineers focused on enhancing DirectX applications. It requires a solid understanding of graphics pipelines, shader programming (HLSL), and familiarity with the Reshade ecosystem.
